extDescription.message: Выравнивает громкие и тихие места на странице: диалоги слышно, взрывы не рвут уши. Настройка запоминается для каждого сайта.
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in the store and the extensions page

enable.description: Button that turns compression on for this site

disable.description: Button that turns compression off for this site

mode_basic.description: Tab: two sliders, amount and volume

mode_advanced.description: Tab: the engine's own three controls plus output

slider_strength.description: Basic slider: further right is stronger

slider_outputDb.description: Basic slider: make-up gain applied after compression

knob_holdAboveDb.description: Knob: LU above the programme loudness where compression and levelling start

knob_reachBelowDb.description: Knob: LU below the programme loudness that levelling reaches down to

knob_outputDb.description: Knob: the same make-up gain, abbreviated to fit the column

response_static.description: Response: gain depends only on the current level

response_adaptive.description: Response: a slow loop chases the programme level

programme.description: Label before the measured programme loudness in LUFS

unavailable.message: Звук на этой странице защищён и не поддаётся обработке
unavailable.description: Shown when every audio source is DRM-protected or CORS-tainted

noAudio.message: Звук на этой странице не найден
noAudio.description: Shown when the page has no audio source at all
